Real files were generated via /api/applications/download and inspected byte-by-byte, not just status-code-checked. (1) BLOCKS CLASSIFICATION: POST /applications/preview for Gujarati 'adjournment' returns blocks where every numbered point '૧.', '૨.', '૩.' has align='left' and bold=false; ONLY the court-heading ('માનનીય ન્યાયાલય…') and the exact title 'મુદત અરજી' are align='center'+bold=true. English affidavit: 'AFFIDAVIT' and 'VERIFICATION' are the only center+bold lines; numbered points 1./2./3. are left+normal. Point 3 is now correctly normal. (2) REAL PDF (Gujarati): raw bytes start with %PDF; pdfminer.six extracted 'મુદત' AND 'અરજદાર' — proves Lohit Gujarati glyphs are embedded (no boxes). English PDF extracts 'AFFIDAVIT','VERIFICATION','Ravi'. (3) REAL DOCX opened with python-docx: paragraphs list matches preview; numbered Gujarati points are LEFT-aligned with run.bold=False; 'માનનીય ન્યાયાલય' + 'મુદત' paragraphs are CENTER+bold. Font 'Lohit Gujarati' present on paragraph runs for gu; 'Times New Roman' present for en. AFFIDAVIT/VERIFICATION are the only CENTER+bold paragraphs in the affidavit DOCX. (4) PDF vs DOCX consistency: identical payload produces the same text tokens (AFFIDAVIT, VERIFICATION, party name, address, statement) in both formats. (5) CERTIFIED COPY order_date is optional: /templates/certified_copy field.required=false; POST /applications/download with values that OMIT order_date returns 200 + valid %PDF; with order_date also 200. (6) CREDIT SAFETY: preview does NOT decrement wallet; a single download decrements exactly by 1; after draining 5 credits, next download returns 402 and balance stays 0 (no accidental deduction). (7) REGRESSION: OTP send/verify 200; /auth/google-session with invalid session_id -> 401; new signup with existing user's referral_code adds +10 to referrer's wallet; GET /templates returns 25 items (>=23) and multilingual q= 'mudat' | 'વિલંબ' | 'vakalat' all return matches. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): full wizard on /template/certified_copy verified — preview-doc block computed styles show 'IN THE COURT OF' font-weight 700 + text-align center; 'APPLICATION FOR CERTIFIED COPY' font-weight 700 + text-align center; every numbered point (1./2./3.) font-weight 400 + text-align left (0 misclassifications). 'Confirm & Download' advanced to the output step showing PDF Document + Word Document cards. Required-field validation still blocks preview: clearing document_desc kept preview-doc invisible. Deprecated packages: NONE detected. SafeAreaView issues: NONE. React Native red-screens: NONE.
action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional: (a) server.py is now 840 lines — still over the 700-line soft cap flagged in prior iterations; consider splitting applications/wallet/templates into routers. (b) Lohit Gujarati has no dedicated Bold TTF — the code maps 'LohitGujarati-Bold' to the same regular face; visually the bold Gujarati headings are the SAME weight as body text (only the font-size differs by 1pt). This is acceptable and better than boxed fallback, but if a bolder heading is desired, ship a real bold face (e.g. Noto Sans Gujarati Bold) and register it under the -Bold name. (c) Consider deleting the now-unused NotoSansGujarati-{Regular,Bold}.ttf files in /app/backend/fonts to keep the bundle lean. (d) Optional cosmetic: certified_copy Gujarati template line 2 renders 'હુકમની તારીખ' with a trailing '____' when order_date is blank — this is fine but you may want to conditionally strip that clause when the value is empty.
critical_code_review_comments: doc_generator.build_blocks() classification is now deterministic: startswith('IN THE COURT OF' / 'માનનીય ન્યાયાલય'), exact title match, or fully-uppercase Latin line containing a heading keyword. The prior fuzzy 'contains અરજી / contains માનનીય' heuristic that made 'Point 3' bold is fully removed. Regex [\u0A80-\u0AFF] correctly excludes Gujarati lines from the English-uppercase check.

generate_pdf and generate_docx both consume the SAME blocks list returned by build_blocks() — preview endpoint also returns the exact same blocks — so preview == PDF == DOCX by construction. Good single source of truth.
DOC_SETTINGS is a proper central config (margins, fonts, sizes). Ready for admin override later.

register_fonts() is idempotent via a module-level flag and safely no-ops if the TTF is missing, so ReportLab won't crash if Lohit is absent (but Gujarati would fall back). File is present at /app/backend/fonts/Lohit-Gujarati.ttf.

In generate_docx, rPr may be None on a fresh run — the qn('w:cs') / w:ascii / w:hAnsi set is wrapped in try/except; safe but silently swallows errors. Consider using run.font.name (which python-docx already handles for w:ascii/hAnsi) and only explicitly setting w:cs for complex-script Gujarati.

Certified Copy field.required=False confirmed in seed_data.py:218 and surfaced correctly through /templates/{id}. Server does no server-side required-field enforcement — it's UI-only — which is intentional since the render substitutes missing keys with '____'.

Credit safety: /applications/download uses a single atomic $inc/$set update filtered on balance:{$gte:1} — race-safe. 402 raised if modified_count==0 AFTER the file was already generated but BEFORE it's returned; balance is preserved. This is correct behaviour.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the exercised template-wizard flow (preview blocks correctly styled, order_date optional, required-field validation still enforced, output step reachable)

rca_of_issue: Original bug root cause (confirmed by reading the fixed code): the previous heading classifier used substring matches — any line containing 'માનનીય ન્યાયાલય' or 'અરજી' or looking uppercase-ish was promoted to bold+center. In the Gujarati adjournment template, Point 3 references the court in prose (…'આ માનનીય ન્યાયાલય…'), so it was mis-classified as a heading in the PDF/DOCX pipeline, while the preview used a different classifier (leading to preview != PDF). Additionally, ReportLab was falling back to a font without Gujarati glyphs, producing boxes. Fix (verified): (a) unified block-builder used by preview + PDF + DOCX with deterministic startswith/exact-title/uppercase-keyword rules; (b) Lohit-Gujarati.ttf bundled and registered as both LohitGujarati and LohitGujarati-Bold so no fallback path can produce boxes; (c) DOCX runs get w:cs/w:ascii/w:hAnsi set to 'Lohit Gujarati' so Word doesn't remap complex script; (d) certified_copy field 'order_date' marked required:false in seed_data.py and the template body uses render_template which fills empty placeholders with '____' so generation succeeds. No live bugs found in this iteration.
